translations./title: Unlocking car doors: list numbers are not tool names
translations./summary: The user asks to unlock all car doors and turn on the headlights. In the tool list, item 16 is `lockDoors` and item 20 is `setHeadlights`. The numbers identify entries in the list; they are not part of the tool names.
translations./presentation/guidance/title: Use the tool names as defined

/presentation/guidance/checks.Continuation: With guidance removed, the agent calls `setHeadlights(mode="on")`. The headlights turn on, the doors remain unlocked, and the task check passes.

translations./presentation/branches/1/summary: The agent uses the correct tool name to unlock the doors, then turns on the headlights.
